facility.name: Longview Child Development Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 601 GARFIELD DR, LONGVIEW, TX, 75602

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: During inspection required training was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Personnel Policies
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Personnel Policies (26 TAC §746.201(2))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Potty-Chairs: This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance. A potty-chair was not sanitized after use with urine still sitting inside of it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Potty-Chairs (26 TAC §746.3407(5))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: This standard was reviewed and found to be out of compliance. A caregiver was observed using food as a reward.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number: Multiple children's records were missing the child's full address information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number (26 TAC §746.605(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Multiple staff members did not have the required training hours for review during the insepction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Multiple children's records were missing the address information for either a physician or an emergency facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present at inspection without a background check. This was corrected at inspection as the caregiver was sent home and the operation submitted the individuals background check request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined that a caregiver has yelled at children as a method of discipline. This caregiver is no longer employed by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined that staff in one classroom failed to demonstrate good judgement when they allowed children to use the restroom in a bucket inside the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft.: The loose fill under the playscape was not at the required depth and grass was seen growing out as well.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Child #1, #2, #4, and #5 need a statement they are healthy to be in care from their physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Four personnel files were reviewed and the following training was not available:  #2 and #4 do not have training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A current fire inspection was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Ten children's files were reviewed and the following information was not available:  Child #4 needs an address for the emergency contact person  All 10 children need the new special care statement completed and signed  Child #6 parent needs to sign emergency care authorization  Child #1, #2, #4, and #5 need a statement they are healthy to be in care from their physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Four staff files were reviewed and two do not have required CPR/1st aid training available for revieiw.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: An emergency practices document was not available for the previous year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Four personnel records were reviewed and #1 does not have an affidavit on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During an abuse/neglect investigation it was observed that a caregiver strapped a child into a restrictive device for at least 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the abuse/neglect investigation a caregiver was observed on her phone while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the preponderance of evidence gathered during the investigation, it is determined that a caregiver did substantially harm a child by using excessive force of dragging the child across the room by one arm and then restraining the child in a chair for punishment for over 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the abuse/neglect investigation a caregiver was observed dragging a child by the arm across the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During inspection, wall borders at bottom have come loose and need to be repaired or removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the DFPS investigation it was determined that a child was slapped on the hand by one caregiver and pushed in the chest area by another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the DFPS investigation it was determined that the operation did not notify CCR that a child was inappropriately disciplined.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: During inspection 6 personnel file were missing the following training:  SIDS/Shaken Baby/Brain Development for infants  Hazardous Materials Training  Food Allergies Training  Emegency Preparedness Training  1st aid/cpr Training
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times: The parent handbook is missing required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times (26 TAC §746.501(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection it was found that a person with a pending background check had at times been watching classrooms with children while the caregivers were on break.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During the walk through I observed two caregivers on their personal phones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: During the inspection multiple caregivers stated that no one was left in charge while the acting director was away from the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walk through I observed a plugged in power strip lying on the counter of a sink inside of a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: During inspection the safety practices document was not available for the current year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the inspection a toilet that children use was observed to be clogged with waste. When asked caregivers stated this toilet has been in this manner for over a week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: During my inspection I observed one of the rooms was not cleaned the night before making the teacher complete janitorial duties leading to the room getting out of control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: During my inspection I observed a child playing in a room by themselves with no caregiver supervision for around 5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The operation could not provide a sigh-in and sign-out log.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: While observing video for the investigation I observed the children watching television for 3 hours. This screen time also overlapped meal time for breakfast at 9:00AM.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection I observed a classroom with a child under two years old watching television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During the inspection I observed a room of children with the youngest being 14 months old and the oldest being 4 years old. This was a 34 month age gap between the youngest and oldest child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based off a DFPS Investigation this Minimum Standard was found to be out of compliance. The caregiver demonstrated poor judgement when they picked up a toddler and slung them onto their nap mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Based on a DFPS Investigation this Minimum Standard was found to be out of compliance. A caregiver was found to have placed a blanket over a toddlers head during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the walk through I observed the ceiling and wall in the cafeteria had water damage. This damage caused the paint and parts of the wall the crumble when touched. I also observed in the Pre-K room part of the wall exposed allowing children to peel at it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease: During the investigation it was found that parents were not being notified of Covid-19 cases within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.307(d))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: During the investigation it was found that the operation was not reporting Covid-19 cases to CCR withing the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
